explanation: OEIS A002454 (a(n) = 4^n (n!)²), Z.-W. Sun: for ζ a primitive (2n+1)-th root of unity, the permanent of the 2n×2n matrix with 1 on the diagonal and (1 + ζ^(j−k))/(1 − ζ^(j−k)) off it equals a(n)/(2n+1) = ((2n)!!)²/(2n+1). The formal statement uses 0-based indices (only j − k matters), integer powers of ζ, and divides a(n) by 2n+1 in ℂ; the n = 0 case (empty matrix, both sides 1) is consistent. Faithful.
